scripts.dev: pnpm build:remotes && concurrently -k -n shell,catalog,cart,account -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm -F @shop/shell dev" "pnpm -F @shop/catalog serve" "pnpm -F @shop/cart serve" "pnpm -F @shop/account serve"
scripts.build:remotes: pnpm -F @shop/catalog build && pnpm -F @shop/cart build && pnpm -F @shop/account build
scripts.preview: concurrently -k -n shell,catalog,cart,account -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm -F @shop/shell preview" "pnpm -F @shop/catalog preview" "pnpm -F @shop/cart preview" "pnpm -F @shop/account preview"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build
